claim: Docker sandbox contains malicious C code execution
scope: Negative security test suite against pre-flight filters and Docker cgroups
limitation: Shares host Linux kernel; microVMs provide stronger hypervisor isolation

claim: Subsystem failure recovery without session corruption
scope: Predefined fault scenarios spanning LLM/evaluator/storage/network
limitation: Empirical coverage of tested faults; not universal mathematical fault tolerance

claim: Concurrent session isolation and zero lock errors
metric/result: 0 lock errors and 0 isolation violations across 1/5/10/25 sessions
scope: SQLite 3 in WAL mode with threading.Lock on single host
limitation: Tested concurrency under workload; scaling past ~150-200 ops/s requires PostgreSQL

claim: Subsystem latency within interactive interview SLA
metric/result: Warm evaluator 1960.8ms mean (P95 2098.6ms); DB write 17.2ms; ScoreValidator 0.004ms
scope: Benchmark across 20-100 timed invocations
limitation: Evaluator requires warm model cache; container cold-start adds ~1.2-1.5s

claim: Qwen LLM strictly isolated from scoring and difficulty decisions
scope: Deterministic gating in orchestrator and score validator
limitation: Qwen text quality relies on heuristic schema and regex validation

claim: Acoustic prosody insulated from technical scoring pipeline
metric/result: 100% insulated; zero audio parameters passed to evaluator
scope: Architectural interface contract (text-only evaluation API)
limitation: No claims of demographic accent equity or bias mitigation

claim: Universal fault tolerance across all possible failure modes
scope: All conceivable hardware and distributed network partitions
limitation: Refuted by scientific boundaries; only 10 tested faults verified

claim: Inviolable security boundary preventing host kernel compromise
scope: Full host kernel security under unpatched vulnerabilities
limitation: Refuted; Docker containerization is defense-in-depth

claim: Evaluator correlates with multi-educator human consensus
scope: N=64 authentic technical explanations across 10 DSA/systems categories
limitation: Evaluated on DSA algorithmic explanations; not general conversational speech

claim: Educator committee exhibits high inter-rater reliability
scope: 3 independent blind human CS educators on 64 items (10 expert-adjudicated)
limitation: Applies strictly to human-human agreement; not model agreement

claim: CrossEncoder reasoning entailment is strongest individual component
metric/result: R-only rho = 0.4832 vs S1 rho = 0.2070 and S2 rho = 0.3021
scope: 7-way ablation evaluated on identical 64-case human gold benchmark
limitation: R-only lacks explicit rubric concept coverage and keyword dampening

claim: Full composite evaluator outperforms R-only in rank correlation
metric/result: Full composite rho = 0.3812 vs R-only rho = 0.4832 (diff = -0.1020)
scope: Ablation comparison on 64 human gold benchmark cases
limitation: Full composite trades raw rank correlation for keyword defense and rubric constraints

claim: Evaluator resists semantic and syntactic metamorphic perturbations
scope: 7 metamorphic relations (MG-1 to MG-7) across 3 benchmark cases
limitation: Repetitive keyword injection in META-02 and META-03 exceeded 0.50 ceiling

claim: Evaluator and ScoreValidator contain adversarial prompt injections
metric/result: 11/13 (84.6%) adversarial attack vectors contained below safety ceilings
scope: 13 distinct attack patterns spanning override/stuffing/jargon/contradiction
limitation: Subtle contradiction (ADV-10: 0.4617) and negation (ADV-11: 0.4328) breached ceilings

claim: CrossEncoder model was fine-tuned specifically for PREPAIred
scope: Interview-specific training loss or domain adaptation
limitation: Refuted; model is off-the-shelf ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 in zero-shot inference

claim: Universal robustness against all adversarial answer manipulations
scope: All conceivable obfuscated or deceptive natural language attacks
limitation: Refuted; metamorphic and adversarial suites represent finite engineering evidence

claim: PPO with guardrails reduces tracking error vs fixed difficulty
metric/result: PPO+Guardrails MAE = 0.677 +/- 0.006 vs Fixed MAE = 1.200 (Cohen d approx 0.87)
scope: 5 simulated candidate personas across 5 eval seeds (N=25 sessions/condition)
limitation: Evaluated in synthetic persona simulator; not live human learners

claim: PPO achieves multi-seed training stability across initializations
metric/result: Mean MAE = 0.677; SD across 5 training seeds = 0.006 (Seeds 42/123/456/789/999)
scope: 5 independent training runs evaluated across identical 25-session test suite
limitation: Demonstrates optimization reproducibility; not asymptotic global optimality

claim: PPO outperforms deterministic heuristic baseline on tracking speed
scope: Comparison across 25 session trajectories per condition
limitation: Heuristic achieves faster tracking; PPO achieves lower volatility (0.088 vs 0.160)

claim: Post-hoc guardrails eliminate out-of-bounds difficulty transitions
metric/result: 0 actual out-of-bounds transitions; 563 guardrail interventions across 5 seeds
scope: Full multi-seed evaluation trajectories (125 total sessions)
limitation: Pre-clipping proposed actions reach boundaries when candidates fail at min difficulty

claim: State Dimension 4 formulation impacts aggregate tracking error
scope: Dimension 4 formulation ablation across 25 evaluation sessions
limitation: s4 has low policy sensitivity in neutral coordinates; guardrails override remaining differences

claim: RL training curves demonstrate action stabilization and reward plateauing
metric/result: Rolling mean rewards plateau and action distributions stabilize within 20k steps
scope: Step-level training logs across all 5 seeds (24576 timesteps/seed)
limitation: Empirical stabilization within training budget; not theoretical convergence proof

claim: Adaptive RL improves human candidate technical learning gains
scope: Longitudinal computing education classroom or interview study
limitation: Refuted; study conducted exclusively on simulated personas

claim: Acoustic prosody causally determines optimal difficulty transitions
metric/result: Speech features modulate pacing guardrails; zero scoring authority
scope: Controlled coordinate sensitivity sweeps around neutral operating point
limitation: Observational sensitivity sweep; not randomized causal inference
